description: Multi-turn gold (Story 5.2, multi-turn gap). Each case is a short CONVERSATION; the harness runs the turns sequentially, feeding each turn the prior (question, answer) as context, and evaluates the FINAL turn. This tests whether a follow-up (pronouns, ellipsis) is handled given the conversation — via query contextualization over the existing single-turn pipeline. Native conversational retrieval is a follow-up. reviewed=false (not SME-validated).

turns.question: On pump P-12, is there a fault code E42?

cases.ground_truth: Fault E42 on pump P-12 indicates a pump overheat; the controller trips the motor.

turns.question: What is the current recommended coolant for the CX-7 chiller?
And what is its exact chemical formula?

cases.ground_truth: The documentation gives the coolant grade (G-48) but not a chemical formula; the follow-up must abstain.

turns.question: Sur la pompe P-12, existe-t-il un code défaut E42 ?

cases.ground_truth: Le code E42 sur la pompe P-12 indique une surchauffe ; le contrôleur déclenche l'arrêt du moteur.
